headwords: lửa thử vàng, gian nan thử sức

flags.why: The example explains the name instead of using it to refer to a hippopotamus.
flags.fix: Con lợn nước đang ngâm mình dưới sông. = The hippopotamus is soaking in the river.

flags.why: Lủm means eating an entire piece in one mouthful, without necessarily swallowing it unchewed, as defined in [Rừng](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/L%E1%BB%A7m).
Lứ is used when addressing a Teochew speaker, rather than being a general Southern pronoun between friends, as documented in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%E1%BB%A9).
flags.fix: you (in Southern Vietnamese, when addressing a Teochew speaker)
